title: Creamy Pork Casserole Delight
description: A rich and satisfying casserole that combines the flavors of pork and creamy sauce, perfect for a cozy evening.
instructions: Season the pork shoulder with salt and black pepper. Sear the pork in a skillet until browned, then set aside.
In the same skillet, sauté the mushrooms until tender. Add the chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
Stir in the creamy sauce and cook until heated through. Add the thyme and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the pork to a casserole dish and spoon the mushroom sauce over the top.
Sprinkle the french bread crumbs over the sauce and dot the top with butter.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pork is cooked through and the casserole is golden brown.
Let the casserole rest for 10 minutes before serving.
